passages.title: Neighbourhood Volunteer Programme
passages.intro: How to take part in local volunteering
paras: Applicants must be at least sixteen years old to volunteer. A group orientation is held on the first Saturday of each month.
Local travel costs can be reimbursed when volunteers submit receipts. The food bank accepts only unopened, in-date packaged donations.
Volunteers are asked to give one week's notice if they cannot attend a shift. A volunteer coordinator confirms each person's shift and duties.
Volunteers must complete training before making home visits. A participation certificate is available after twenty completed volunteer hours.

passages.title: Farmers' Market Visitor Guide
paras: The farmers' market is open every Saturday morning. The first hour is intended for shoppers who prefer a quieter environment.
Most vendors accept debit or credit cards, although a few remain cash-only. Visitors are encouraged to bring reusable shopping bags.
Dogs are welcome outdoors if kept on a short lead. Market visitors receive ninety minutes of free parking.
Hot-food vendors are grouped near the south entrance. Some sellers reduce prices on remaining produce shortly before closing.
